findings.issue: Generated-tree bounds and symlink/type inventory run only after the host binary has executed. Before launch the controller only hashes binary; that follows symlinks and applies no32MiB/64-member check. The later inventory hashes a file before testing its declared total size and eagerly sorts an unbounded traversal.
findings.minimum_fix: After compiler closure and before binary launch, perform a bounded no-symlink generated-tree inventory. Count members and accumulate regular-file sizes before hashing;refuse over limit or unexpected types immediately. Validate/hash the regular binary from that bounded inventory,then launch it. Retain a bounded post-run/cleanup inventory and preserve artifacts on ambiguity.

findings.issue: The cutoff timestamp is assigned after sigpending is sampled. A blocked signal arriving after the snapshot but before cutoff is a pre-cutoff signal absent from observed;installing SIG_IGN can discard it and allow passed. No explicit post-cutoff observation scope is retained,and observations hashing occurs after cutoff.
findings.minimum_fix: Use the reviewed one-way finite-cutoff protocol:finish command/cleanup/source/binary/generated hashes and observations digest first;assign cutoff before the protected signal snapshot,or use explicit record-only pre/post-cutoff handlers with an equivalent no-gap boundary. Pre-cutoff observations reject;later signals are expressly outside the completed observation. No compiler/hash/parse follows cutoff;receipt publication alone follows.

findings.issue: Control bytes used for execution and roster selection are not all pinned. Plan bytes are parsed before a separate path rehash;input-manifest and test-family-map are parsed without their sealed expected digests,and neither is added to before/after pins. Thus all_pins_rechecked does not establish custody of the actual control data used.
findings.minimum_fix: Anchor the exact frozen v2 seal/member roster in the root release/controller. Bounded-read control bytes,verify those same bytes against sealed lengths/digests before parsing/using them,and retain plan,manifest,test roster and other preparation/control-file pins in pre/post custody. Derive the24 distinct expected names from the verified roster;reject duplicate JSON keys or member/path collisions.

nonblocking_source_observations: Two command calls are serial and the second follows successful expected compile exit;absolute offsets share START.
stdout/stderr retained buffers are capped,and output-cap failures propagate through ERRORS.
The child is retained before custody checks;WNOWAIT observation precedes all group signaling;leader is reaped only after signals finish.
Unknown closure,cleanup failure and posthash failure append ERRORS,which gates passed;source review does not establish runtime availability or success.
